core_principles: Negative Space is Luxury: Use 40% screen real estate for whitespace.
Asymmetry creates Tension: Avoid perfect centering everywhere.
Text is Texture: Typography is the main graphic element.
Scarcity is Key: UI should feel like a countdown or a limited access event.

font_family.heading: Inter, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
font_family.body: Inter, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

styles.display_massive: text-7xl md:text-9xl font-black tracking-tighter uppercase leading-none
styles.heading_xl: text-5xl md:text-7xl font-bold tracking-tighter uppercase leading-none

usage_rules.background: ALWAYS Pure White (#FFFFFF). No off-whites for main backgrounds.
usage_rules.text: ALWAYS Pure Black (#000000). No dark greys for body text.
usage_rules.accent: Use International Orange (#FF4F00) SPARINGLY. Only for: 'Enter' buttons, 'Sold Out' badges, and tiny UI accents (1-2% of screen).
usage_rules.borders: Use 1px solid black or light grey borders for separation. NO SHADOWS.

visual_enhancers.texture: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 0.03) allowed on solid backgrounds to prevent 'digital flatness'.

layout.grid_system: Use CSS Grid with 12 columns. Overlap elements deliberately.

buttons.primary: rounded-none bg-black text-white hover:bg-[#FF4F00] hover:text-white transition-colors duration-300 px-8 py-4 uppercase tracking-widest text-sm font-bold
buttons.secondary: rounded-none border border-black bg-transparent text-black hover:bg-black hover:text-white transition-colors duration-300 px-8 py-4 uppercase tracking-widest text-sm font-bold
buttons.ghost: text-black hover:text-[#FF4F00] uppercase tracking-widest text-xs font-bold

cards.product: group relative border-r border-b border-black/10 p-4 hover:bg-neutral-50 transition-colors
cards.archive: opacity-60 grayscale hover:opacity-100 hover:grayscale-0 transition-all duration-500

inputs.default: rounded-none border-b border-black bg-transparent px-0 py-4 text-lg focus:border-[#FF4F00] focus:ring-0 placeholder:text-neutral-400

hero_portal.desc: Main portal reveal image. Two models in white tees, minimalist.

product_drop_001.desc: Secondary product shot or lookbook image. Woman in white shirt.

texture_abstract.desc: Abstract architectural form for subtle overlays.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. THEME SETUP: Update `tailwind.config.js` immediately to extend colors with the specific Palette defined above. Set `borderRadius` to `0px` globally.
2. PORTAL FIRST: The Homepage ('/') must be the 'Portal'. It is NOT a shop grid. It is a single, immersive screen with a countdown and an 'ENTER' button that unlocks the actual shop.
3. NAVIGATION: The nav bar should be hidden or extremely minimal on the Portal. On the Shop page, use a sticky minimalist header with a 'Menu' text button triggering a full-screen overlay.
4. PRODUCT GRID: Use a 'Bento' style grid for the shop. Not all product cards should be the same size. Make the latest drop ('Drop 001') take up 2x2 columns.
5. TYPOGRAPHY: Use 'Inter' but apply `tracking-tighter` and `font-bold` to all headings to simulate a premium grotesque font.
6. ACCESSIBILITY: Ensure all white text on images has a subtle black scrim/gradient behind it, or use mixed-blend-mode: difference (carefully).
7. TESTING: Add `data-testid` to every interactive element (buttons, inputs, links).
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients. Use solid colors.
Do not use rounded corners. Everything is sharp (0px).
Do not use generic 'Lorem Ipsum'. Use the copy provided in the prompt ('WE KNOW YOU LOOKED', 'NOT FOR EVERYONE').
Do not center text by default. Left align is stronger for this brutalist style.
